Grab your pineapple, we're diving deep tonight 🍍🌊 Azucar's Main Floor is turning into full-on Bikini Bottom for one night only — SpongeBob drag realness, wig snatches, and chaotic karma courtesy of your host Tahboo. Four queens, one ocean floor, zero chill. Come in costume or don't come at all (kidding... kinda). The bass drops like a jellyfish sting, the looks are giving barnacle bling, and the energy is pure Krusty Krab on a Thursday rush. This ain't your average drag night — it's a full underwater universe and you're invited to get weird in it. Pull up early, the floor fills fast and nobody wants to miss the first splash. 18+ only, so leave the goofy goobers at home. 🧽💅

📅 Thursday, October 22 — Doors 8PM, Show 9PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $10 online / $15 at door
🔞 18+
